title: A screen flow's select options and screen `description` have no key in the `flows` translation face — the zh-CN intake wizard translates its labels and placeholders and keeps its options and body text in English (17.7.0)
body:
Ruled: A — the engine picks the translated `description` and `title` templates before the per-run render; objectui stops overlaying `title` (batch #308 item 1, maintainer 「22507 同意」, ruling 6093472708, 2026-10-10T03:51Z). Label `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue` in the same act.

Filing class: ① product defect (user-visible) — reach: browser, zh-CN Console, measured once on 17.7.0.

**Reader:** objectstack triage → the spec lane (`TranslationDataSchema.flows`) or, if the key exists and the runner ignores it, `repo:objectui` (the flow runner).

## Symptom

Measured in `objectstack-ai/hotclm` on 17.7.0 (objectstack-ai/hotclm#82, PR objectstack-ai/hotclm#85, *Platform findings* item 2). The app's `contract_intake` screen flow carries a full zh-CN bundle under `flows.contract_intake.screens.<node>.{title, fields.<field>.{label, placeholder}}`, and those render in Chinese. In the same wizard:

- select-field options render in English (`Head office`, `USD — US Dollar`) — the face has no key for a screen field's options;
- the screen's body text (`description`) renders in English — the schema's own guidance places `description` outside the face.

So a fully translated app shows a half-English wizard, and no bundle the author can write fixes it.

## Expected

Either the face addresses screen-field options (and, if intended, screen `description`), or the runner resolves options that mirror an object field through that object's translated option labels. Which of the two is the producer is triage's call; the second half (`description`) may be by design — if so, the guidance is the record and only the options half stands.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on this repo, query `flow screen translation select options description not translatable flows translation face screen field options` → 6 hits, all closed and none on options: #7646 (bundle had no screen-flow surface), #11287 (nothing read `flows`), #17306 (screen field numeric bound / help text), #20318 (launcher header key). Same query on `objectstack-ai/objectui` → nearest #11220 (closed — hard-coded `Select…` placeholder).

---
_Filed by the `repo:hotclm` PM seat from a measured dev finding._
